title: Runtime Probe Charter
description: Charter that scopes a runtime probe run. It declares the mission, target environment, in-scope invariants, allowed credentials, probe sequence, expected evidence, and side-effect policy consumed through `devai sense run`.

id.description: Stable charter id. Free-form within the pattern; not minted from a counter (charters are authored artifacts, not generated).

kind.description: Which runtime-probe family executes this charter. api = HTTP/GraphQL/RPC; auth = RBAC/session/protected-surface; data = DB/state/consistency.

mission.description: Plain-language statement of what this probe set is verifying.

base_url.description: Base URL for the deployed runtime under probe. For data-kind probes this may be a DB connection string instead.

deployed_artifact_ref.description: Optional artifact-of-record id for evidence cross-referencing.

threat_model.description: Free-form threat model: what surfaces are sensitive, what side effects are explicitly allowed/forbidden.

in_scope_invariants.description: Invariants this probe set claims to exercise. Failures map back to these ids.

secret_ref.description: Reference to a secret (env var, vault path); the charter never inlines secrets.

pid.description: Probe id within this charter (P1, P2, …). Stable across charter revisions.

method.description: HTTP method or RPC verb (api/auth kinds).

path.description: URL path or RPC name (api/auth kinds).

body.description: Optional request body for the probe.

contains.description: Substrings expected in the response body.

absent.description: Substrings that MUST NOT appear (e.g., leaked PII).

invariant.description: Optional invariant this probe is the observable for.

policy.description: Default: read-only. Probes that write must declare so explicitly.

isolation_note.description: For destructive_with_isolation: how isolation is achieved (per-test tenant, sandbox env, etc.).
